question: How can I budget and track bills on Android without linking my bank account?
normalizedProblem: Users want household budgeting and bill tracking without sharing bank login credentials or syncing transactions to third-party cloud servers.
desiredOutcome: Maintain an accurate monthly budget and bill schedule locally on Android.
currentWorkaround: Manual spreadsheets or paper notebooks that lack mobile due-date notifications.
evidenceNote: Core product positioning verified against Smart Bill Manager local Room/SQLite architecture; GSC query volume pending owner export.
productRelevanceNote: Direct match: local-first Room database with zero bank login required.

suggestedAction.summary: Maintain dedicated problem-solution landing page with Safe-to-Spend & Budget Calculator links.

question: Is there an Android receipt scanner that extracts totals offline without uploading receipts to the cloud?
normalizedProblem: Paper thermal receipts fade quickly, and privacy-conscious users avoid cloud OCR scanners that upload itemized purchase photos.
desiredOutcome: Extract merchant, date and total on-device and attach the photo locally.
currentWorkaround: Keeping shoeboxes of paper receipts or unindexed phone camera photos.
evidenceNote: Verified on-device ML Kit OCR capability in Android codebase; monthly AI search test query #6.
competitorAlternatives: Cloud business expense scanners, phone photo albums
productRelevanceNote: Direct match: on-device OCR with `intent://scan` deep link.

suggestedAction.summary: Landing page with 1-tap `scan` deep link and thermal receipt warranty cross-links.

question: How much are my weekly, monthly, and yearly subscriptions actually costing me per year?
normalizedProblem: Mixed billing cycles (weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual) hide the true annualized household drain of recurring subscriptions.
desiredOutcome: Convert all recurring subscriptions into one monthly equivalent, annual total, and 5-year projection.
currentWorkaround: Mental math or ad-hoc spreadsheet formulas during annual cleanups.
evidenceNote: Mirrors `SubscriptionTrackerEngine.calculateCosts` in Android app; shipped in Phase 5.
productRelevanceNote: Direct match: free browser calculator + in-app renewal & price-hike tracking.

suggestedAction.summary: Interactive client-only Subscription Cost Calculator with deep link to recurring tracking.

question: How do I know how much of my checking balance is actually safe to spend before my next payday?
normalizedProblem: Raw bank balances include money already committed to upcoming rent, utilities, and annual renewals due before payday.
desiredOutcome: See discretionary funds remaining after subtracting upcoming unpaid bills and essentials.
currentWorkaround: Subtracting bills on a phone calculator before every purchase.
evidenceNote: Core Safe-to-Spend hero card on `BillsTabScreen` + free web Safe-to-Spend Calculator.
productRelevanceNote: Direct match: core Safe-to-Spend engine in Android app and web tool.

suggestedAction.summary: Safe-to-Spend Calculator paired with `/safe-to-spend/` and explanatory guides.

normalizedProblem: When electronics or appliances fail, users cannot find the original receipt or miss the warranty claim deadline.
